puddle_blocker: Restricted one-index GEP and pointer/int casts are modeled; this call delegates to a helper that recognizes GEP chains and needs chain/use analysis.

description: Sink ptrtoint through an insert into an inttoptr-converted vector, replacing the scalar with ptrtoint(scalar).
extra_conditions: vector element width equals pointer size
puddle_blocker: Requires vector insertelement semantics, which are unavailable; restricted pointer/int cast semantics are modeled.

description: Delegate remaining ptrtoint simplifications to commonCastTransforms.
Replace ptrtoaddr(ptrmask(P,M)) with and(ptrtoaddr(P),M).
puddle_blocker: The matched ptrmask and ptrtoaddr intrinsic semantics are not modeled; this is not a general pointer-representation blocker.

description: Delegate ptrtoaddr of a GEP chain or integer-derived pointer to foldPtrToIntOrAddrOfGEP.
extra_conditions: helper recognizes a one-use GEP chain from inttoptr or null pointer
puddle_blocker: Restricted one-index GEP and pointer/int casts are modeled; this call delegates to a helper that recognizes GEP chains and needs chain/use analysis.

description: Delegate remaining ptrtoaddr simplifications to commonCastTransforms.
Replace an integer assembled from one-use bitcasts, zero-extensions, shifts and ORs with a vector initialized to zero and populated by insertelement operations.
extra_conditions: all bits decompose into unique element-sized slots
shift offsets and element sizes align
puddle_blocker: Requires vector insertion and endianness/data-layout reasoning.

description: Replace bitcast(extractelement(vector,index)) with extractelement(bitcast(vector to vector-of-destination-elements), index).
extra_conditions: destination type is a legal vector element type
puddle_blocker: Requires vector bitcast and extractelement semantics; Puddle scalar runtime does not model vector elements.

description: Replace bitcast(extractelement(<1 x T>, index)) to a vector destination with bitcast of the one-element source vector.
puddle_blocker: Requires vector element-count and bitcast semantics.

description: For vector FP bitcasts around a bitwise operation, convert both operands to one common integer/FP vector type, perform the same and/or/xor, then bitcast to the destination FP vector; handles either operand orientation.
extra_conditions: outer bitcast and logic op each have one use
one unwrapped side is FP vector and the other integer vector
puddle_blocker: Vector bit reinterpretation and FP bit pattern semantics are outside Puddle.

description: Move a vector bitcast through and/or/xor when one operation operand is a one-use bitcast from a nonconstant value of the destination type; handles either operand order.
extra_conditions: outer bitcast and binary op have one use
destination and operation types are integer or integer-vector
puddle_blocker: This helper explicitly requires vector result and operation types; Puddle has no vector bitcast/elementwise logic semantics.

description: Canonicalize bitcast(logic(x, constant)) to logic(bitcast(x), bitcast(constant)) for vector bitwise operations.
extra_conditions: outer operation is one-use bitwise logic
destination and operation types are vectors
puddle_blocker: Requires vector bitcast and elementwise logic semantics.

description: Move bitcast through a select with a constant arm by bitcasting both arms and selecting in the destination type.
extra_conditions: at least one arm is constant
vector result element count is no larger than source vector count
analysis_audit_note: ElementCount::isKnownLE compares source/destination vector type lane counts, not runtime SSA values.

description: Move bitcast through a select arm that is a one-use bitcast from the destination type, bitcasting the opposite arm; handles true and false arm symmetrically.
extra_conditions: source and destination have the same scalar/vector category
selected arm cast has one use and its input is nonconstant

description: Replace a closed web of opposite bitcasts and PHIs with PHIs in the source type, combining eligible simple loads and redirecting stores and cast users to the new PHIs.
extra_conditions: all incoming values are constants, eligible simple single-use loads, matching reverse bitcasts or PHIs in the web
all old-PHI users are eligible simple stores, matching reverse bitcasts or PHIs in the web
puddle_blocker: Requires cyclic PHI/control-flow graph rewriting and load/store mutation; the relevant operations are effects rejected by SupportedOpCode, and Puddle does not model CFG rewrites.

description: Replace bitcast((bitcast(x) & signmask) | y) to FP with copysign(bitcast(y),x) when y is known nonnegative.
extra_conditions: destination is FP or FP vector
puddle_blocker: Requires nonnegative value analysis and FP sign-bit/copysign semantics.

description: Remove a bitcast whose source and destination types are identical.
Delegate fixed-vector bitcast(zext/trunc(bitcast(vector))) resize patterns to optimizeVectorResizeWithIntegerBitCasts.
extra_conditions: source is integer from zext/trunc of vector bitcast
puddle_blocker: Vector shuffle and endianness semantics are outside Puddle.

description: Delegate integer OR assemblies bitcast to vectors to optimizeIntegerToVectorInsertions.
extra_conditions: integer input decomposes into vector elements
puddle_blocker: Vector insertion and endianness semantics are outside Puddle.

description: Replace bitcast of an extract from a one-element vector to a scalar with a scalar bitcast of the extracted element.
puddle_blocker: Requires extracting from a one-element vector, which is outside Puddle scalar runtime semantics.

description: Replace bitcast(insert(<1 x T>, x, 0)) to a vector destination with bitcast(x).
extra_conditions: source is insert into one-element vector
puddle_blocker: Requires vector insertelement and bitcast semantics outside Puddle scalar runtime.

description: Rewrite bitcast(insert(bitcast(x),y,0)) to (x & high_mask) | zext(y), normalizing inserted index for endianness.
extra_conditions: destination is integer and insertion scalar integer
puddle_blocker: Requires bit-level vector layout and target endianness semantics.

description: Move a bitcast before a one-use shuffle when destination, shuffle result, and input vectors have equal element counts and a shuffle operand is a bitcast from the destination type.
extra_conditions: destination and both shuffle input vector element counts match
puddle_blocker: Requires vector shuffle-mask and bitcast elementwise semantics outside Puddle scalar runtime.

description: Replace a one-use reverse shuffle of byte or bit elements followed by scalar bitcast with bswap or bitreverse intrinsic.
extra_conditions: shuffle has even element count, one use, reverse mask and poison second input
source elements are i8 with legal destination width for bswap, or i1 for bitreverse
puddle_blocker: Vector shuffle masks and bit/byte layout semantics are not modeled by Puddle.

description: Delegate bitcast of PHI to optimizeBitCastFromPhi.
extra_conditions: helper validates a closed opposite-cast PHI web
puddle_blocker: Requires PHI/control-flow graph and memory rewriting.

description: Delegate bitcast of vector extraction to canonicalizeBitCastExtElt.
puddle_blocker: Requires vector extract and bitcast semantics.

description: Delegate to foldBitCastBitwiseLogic.
extra_conditions: helper recognizes vector bitwise logic pattern
puddle_blocker: Requires vector bitcast/elementwise logic semantics.

description: Delegate to foldBitCastSelect.
puddle_blocker: Requires vector select/bitcast semantics in vector cases.

description: Replace the bitcast with copysign result from foldCopySignIdioms when its sign-mask pattern and nonnegative operand guard pass.
puddle_blocker: Requires nonnegative-value analysis and FP copysign semantics.

description: Delegate remaining bitcast simplification to commonCastTransforms.
Delegate addrspacecast simplification to commonCastTransforms.
puddle_blocker: Puddle does not model addrspacecast/address-space conversion semantics; its restricted pointer/int casts and one-index GEP support do not cover this operation.

description: Delegate uitofp simplification to commonCastTransforms.

When truncating element count, replace bitcast(cast(bitcast(vector))) with a shuffle selecting the least-significant source elements (front for little endian, back for big endian) and poison for the unused second operand.
extra_conditions: source fixed vector has more elements than destination
element types match or have equal bit width
shuffle mask selects low-significance elements according to DataLayout endianness
puddle_blocker: Requires vector shuffle masks, poison/zero vectors, and data-layout endianness semantics.

description: When extending element count, replace bitcast(cast(bitcast(vector))) with a shuffle of all source elements plus zero elements at the most-significant end (front for big endian, back for little endian).
extra_conditions: source fixed vector has fewer elements than destination
element types match or have equal bit width
zero padding is placed according to DataLayout endianness
puddle_blocker: Requires vector shuffle masks, poison/zero vectors, and data-layout endianness semantics.
